scope: Action flags in result.json describe direct agent actions, not a claim that every host process or automatic verifier had no side effects.
directAgentGitActions: Read-only rev-parse, symbolic-ref, show-ref and the required existing verifier; no publication, commit, push, ref/config mutation or real-index repair command was issued.
unchangedAuthorizedVerifierContains: git write-tree with GIT_INDEX_FILE set to the retained temporary snapshot/index; it was not changed or replaced.
preparedScratchIndexDifference: Actual bytes and mode match the prepared inventory; mtime differs. No operation-start scratch inventory was captured, so attribution is UNKNOWN since preparation. Actual mtime was preserved, not restored or allowlisted.
actualRefs: Logical ref differences were retained with UNKNOWN attribution; no refs were reset.
